other.deposition_strategy: start printing one side of each layer from the central line, then line by line to fill the other side, then skin to make perimeter

evidence.quote: Waspaloy walls manufactured by LMD powder had dimensions of 10.2 × 55 × 36.2 mm3 (Fig. 2a). The manufacturing parameters were 500 W for laser power with a traverse speed of 200 mm/min. The raw material shows a homogeneous size distribution with a D50 value of around 60 µm. Hastelloy X plate was used as substrates in these applications.

The other geometry, corresponding to IN718 prism, is manufactured by a wire-LMD process to dimensions of 15 × 15 × 120 mm3 (Fig. 2b). The process parameters were set as 900 W power and 1200 mm/min wire feeding rate. IN718 feedstock wire thickness measured 1 ± 0.01 mm. Low carbon steel plates were used as baseplates. The scanning strategy was ± 45° rotation after each layer.
Besides As-Built (AB) condition, several IN718 prisms have undergone Direct-Aging (DA) of 720 °C for 8 h + 620 °C for 8 h and then furnace cooling.

The main difference between the two conditions studied, AB and DA, is based on the presence of fine γ ′ - γ’’ precipitates in the DA condition, which are known to form and grow during the heat treatment of the material [ 31 , 32 ].
